bib.title: Using DeepSpeed and Megatron to Train Megatron-Turing NLG 530B, A Large-Scale Generative Language Model

read.skipped: References skimmed; qualitative sample tables 13-17 skimmed only

question: How can a 530B-parameter dense transformer be trained efficiently with 3D parallelism, and how good is the resulting model on benchmarks, bias probes and in-context learning?
hypothesis: Scaling a monolithic dense model to 530B with a carefully curated corpus and stable recipe yields better zero-, one- and few-shot accuracy.
contributions: 3D parallel training system combining DeepSpeed pipeline/data parallelism with Megatron tensor slicing
Curated 339B-token training corpus and data-processing pipeline
Evaluation on eight benchmarks, bias study and analysis of in-context learning on HANS

method.summary: MT-NLG is a 105-layer decoder-only transformer with 530B parameters trained on 270B tokens from a blend of 15 datasets (Pile subsets, two filtered Common Crawl snapshots, RealNews, CC-Stories) on Selene with 8-way tensor, 35-way pipeline and data parallelism. Evaluated zero/one/few-shot on eight tasks via lm-evaluation-harness.

datasets.name: MT-NLG training blend (15 datasets)
datasets.size: 339B tokens in the dataset; 270B tokens trained on
datasets.split: 2% held out for validation (5.5B-token validation set)
datasets.source: Pile subsets (Books3, OpenWebText2, Stack Exchange, PubMed Abstracts, Wikipedia, PG-19, BookCorpus2, NIH ExPorter, ArXiv, GitHub, Pile-CC), CC-2020-50, CC-2021-04, RealNews, CC-Stories
datasets.preprocessing: CC: pycld2 + jusText (~25% of docs English with non-empty body); 2-gram fastText quality classifier (90.3% held-out accuracy; positives 500000 OpenWebText2, 295000 Wikipedia, 5000 Books3); Pareto filter alpha=3 removing ~80% of text; fuzzy dedup with HashingVectorizer 1,048,576 features, MinHash LSH 20 bands of 13 (260 hashes), Jaccard>=0.8; ftfy; langdetect; drop docs <512 chars; drop docs with 'javascript' and <256 chars; n-gram removal of downstream task text with 200-char margins; 319,781,622 docs after dedup; per-dataset tokens/weights/epochs in Table 1 (e.g. Books3 25.7B/14.3%/1.5, OpenWebText2 14.8B/19.3%/3.6, CC-2021-04 82.6B/15.7%/0.5, GitHub 24.3B/1.6%/0.2)

datasets.name: LAMBADA, RACE-h, BoolQ, Winogrande, HellaSWAG, PiQA, ANLI R2, HANS, WiC
datasets.size: HANS: 30000 test examples (1000 per template x 30 subcases) and 30000 train examples for shots
datasets.preprocessing: HANS implemented in lm-evaluation-harness by authors

training.lr_schedule: linear warmup then cosine decay to 10% of peak over 340 billion tokens
training.batch_size: 1920 global; ramped from 32 in increments of 32 over the first 12B tokens
training.hardware: NVIDIA Selene, 560 DGX A100 nodes (8x 80GB A100 each); 8-way tensor, 35-way pipeline (280 GPUs per replica) plus data parallelism; 1F1B schedule

other.throughput: batch 1920 on 280/350/420 DGX A100 servers: iteration 60.1/50.2/44.4 s, 126/121/113 TFLOP/s per GPU
other.memory: 20 bytes per parameter with Adam mixed precision; >10 TB for weights/grads/optimizer; activation boundary memory 16.9 TB, 8.8 GB with 1920 micro-batches

inference.decoding: zero-shot LAMBADA greedy; other tasks score candidate continuations by likelihood
inference.samples: 800 generations per prompt in adjective co-occurrence; benchmark evaluation single pass, no seeds stated
inference.prompting: zero/one/few-shot, few-shot counts follow GPT-3 without search; HANS 'sanitized' shots from different subcases; HANS 32-shot for subcase table

parameters.likelihood: candidate probability normalised by token count unless stated; RACE uses P(completion|context)/P(completion|answer context)

metrics.name: accuracy
metrics.definition: fraction correct, by highest-likelihood candidate (greedy last word for zero-shot LAMBADA)

metrics.name: validation cross-entropy
metrics.definition: loss on 16M consecutive tokens (4 iterations at batch 1920) of shuffled 5.5B-token validation set

metrics.name: occupation bias score
metrics.definition: mean over occupations of log P(female)-log P(male)

baselines: supervised: ALBERT ensemble, T5+UDG, UNICORN, InfoBERT
eval.protocol: lm-evaluation-harness with task-specific changes; single run reported

availability.code: not stated beyond DeepSpeed and Megatron-LM references

limits: No ablation of data mixture, filtering threshold or learning rate; stability remarks (init std, beta2, lr) are observations without runs shown
Paper does not state total wall-clock, GPU-hours or number of GPUs for the full 270B-token run; throughput measured only at batch 1920 on 280-420 servers
Single run, no seeds or variance for benchmarks
Authors say the model has severe ethnicity/religion bias and should not be deployed as-is; religion study uses only three templates
Authors say they did not search the number of shots
